s0301.literal: Granted to guichi Heba'ertu the two thousand eight hundred twenty households of He, Zhen, Chu, and other places he had recruited, letting him administer them himself.
s0301.idiomatic: The 2,820 households of He, Zhen, Chu, and other places recruited by guichi Heba'ertu were granted to him to administer himself.

s0302.literal: On xinyou day Suodu campaigned against Champa and was granted a camel-hair canopy to ward off miasma.
s0302.idiomatic: On xinyou day Suodu campaigned against Champa and received a camel-hair canopy to ward off miasma.

s0303.literal: Champa sent tribute of elephants and rhinoceros.
s0303.idiomatic: Champa sent tribute of elephants and rhinoceros.

s0304.literal: Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan and others were ordered to perform red rituals to Heaven at Shouning Palace for five days and nights.
s0304.idiomatic: Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan and others were ordered to perform red rituals to Heaven at Shouning Palace for five days and nights.

s0305.literal: Eighth month, jiazi new moon: pacification commissioner Fang Wen spoke on six matters — selecting prefects and magistrates, honoring sacrificial rites, restraining corrupt officials, banning banditry, regulating troops, and rewarding loyalty and righteousness; an edict ordered court officials and elders to discuss and implement them.
s0305.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiazi new moon: pacification commissioner Fang Wen spoke on six matters — selecting prefects and magistrates, honoring sacrificial rites, restraining corrupt officials, banning banditry, regulating troops, and rewarding loyalty and righteousness; an edict ordered court officials and elders to discuss and carry them out.

s0306.literal: On bingyin day Mars transgressed the third star west of the Feudal Lords.
s0306.idiomatic: On bingyin day Mars transgressed the third star west of the Feudal Lords.

s0307.literal: On gengwu day Mangudai was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat and directed Central Secretariat affairs.
s0307.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mangudai was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat and directed Central Secretariat affairs.

s0308.literal: On xinwei day an edict directed Longxing Branch Secretariat associate administrator Liu Heba'ertu to take exclusive charge of all revenue, grain, and construction.
s0308.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict directed Longxing Branch Secretariat associate administrator Liu Heba'ertu to take exclusive charge of all revenue, grain, and construction.

s0309.literal: On yihai day all appanage households in Ganzhou were required to perform relay service according to commoner precedent.
s0309.idiomatic: On yihai day all appanage households in Ganzhou were required to perform relay service according to commoner precedent.

s0310.literal: Strict prohibitions against extorting the people were enforced at the Dadu metropolitan administration, horse-and-troop office, and left and right patrol courts.
s0310.idiomatic: Strict prohibitions against extorting the people were enforced at the Dadu metropolitan administration, horse-and-troop office, and left and right patrol courts.

s0311.literal: On gengyin day, because Alahan had died, Atahai and others were ordered to garrison Sanhaikou in divisions, and Atahai was directed to recruit the remaining sea bandits.
s0311.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because Alahan had died, Atahai and others were ordered to garrison Sanhaikou in divisions, and Atahai was directed to recruit the remaining sea bandits.

s0312.literal: Goryeo King Wang Chun sent his Military Affairs Bureau envoy Han Kang to congratulate the emperor on his birthday.
s0312.idiomatic: Goryeo King Wang Chun sent his Military Affairs Bureau envoy Han Kang to congratulate the emperor on his birthday.

s0313.literal: On renchen day, because six relay stations in Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine, twelve thousand bolts of silks and cloth were ordered issued; those who had sold wives and children were redeemed by the state.
s0313.idiomatic: On renchen day, because six relay stations in Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine, 12,000 bolts of silks and cloth were ordered issued; those who had sold wives and children were redeemed by the state.

s0314.literal: An edict ordered that returning troops from the Japan expedition be provisioned with grain by officials wherever they passed.
s0314.idiomatic: An edict ordered that returning troops from the Japan expedition be provisioned with grain by officials wherever they passed.

s0315.literal: The armies of Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, Fan Wenhu, Li Ting, Jin Fangqing, and others, their ships battered by wind and waves, suffered great defeat; the remaining troops returned to Goryeo territory, one or two in ten surviving.
s0315.idiomatic: The armies of Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, Fan Wenhu, Li Ting, Jin Fangqing, and others, their ships battered by wind and waves, suffered great defeat; the remaining troops returned to Goryeo territory, only one or two in ten surviving.

s0316.literal: Ritual offerings were performed at Shouning Palace in Shangdu.
s0316.idiomatic: Ritual offerings were performed at Shouning Palace in Shangdu.

s0317.literal: Granted price payments for sheep and horses to the Huanzhiwu tribe and Mieqili and others, and paper currency for sheep and horses to various household slaves who had aided the army.
s0317.idiomatic: Price payments for sheep and horses were granted to the Huanzhiwu tribe and Mieqili and others, and paper currency for sheep and horses to various household slaves who had aided the army.

s0318.literal: Granted to impoverished troops of the Changhe division; grain was issued to troops passing through Western Sichuan.
s0318.idiomatic: Impoverished troops of the Changhe division were granted relief, and grain was issued to troops passing through Western Sichuan.

s0319.literal: Various Hainan countries sent tribute of elephants, rhinoceros, and local products.
s0319.idiomatic: Various Hainan countries sent tribute of elephants, rhinoceros, and local products.

s0320.literal: Issued grain rations to keshik; the lands they occupied were seized for garrison farming.
s0320.idiomatic: Grain rations were issued to keshik, and the lands they occupied were seized for garrison farming.

s0321.literal: Intercalary month, guisi new moon: Mars transgressed the second star south of the Office of Strangeness.
s0321.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guisi new moon: Mars transgressed the second star south of the Office of Strangeness.

s0322.literal: Atahai asked to use the Sanhaikou garrison troops to attack Fujian bandit Chen Diaoyan; an edict declined because of excessive fatigue.
s0322.idiomatic: Atahai asked to use the Sanhaikou garrison troops to attack Fujian bandit Chen Diaoyan; an edict declined because of excessive fatigue.

s0323.literal: Ordered the guard troops garrisoning the Jingshan route to return to the capital.
s0323.idiomatic: The guard troops garrisoning the Jingshan route were ordered to return to the capital.

s0324.literal: On renchen day Gua Prefecture garrison farm presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.
s0324.idiomatic: On renchen day Gua Prefecture garrison farm presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.

s0325.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0325.idiomatic: On bingwu day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0326.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Mao.
s0326.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Mao.

s0327.literal: On dingsi day Bozhou was ordered to present local tribute in person each year; the Sizhou pacification commission was changed to a pacification and consolation commission, also administering the internal pacification commissioner.
s0327.idiomatic: On dingsi day Bozhou was ordered to present local tribute in person each year; the Sizhou pacification commission was changed to a pacification and consolation commission, also administering the internal pacification commissioner.

s0328.literal: Goryeo's Bureau of Deliberation was promoted to third rank, subordinate grade.
s0328.idiomatic: Goryeo's Bureau of Deliberation was promoted to third rank, subordinate grade.

s0329.literal: Ordered the Central Secretariat to reduce redundant executive and various office personnel.
s0329.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was ordered to reduce redundant executive and various office personnel.

s0330.literal: Sent Uryangqadai to transport six thousand shi of grain from Shacheng and elsewhere into Karakorum.
s0330.idiomatic: Uryangqadai was sent to transport 6,000 shi of grain from Shacheng and elsewhere into Karakorum.

s0331.literal: Registered Jiangnan household population and tax levies.
s0331.idiomatic: Jiangnan household population and tax levies were registered.

s0332.literal: On gengshen day Annam sent tribute of local products.
s0332.idiomatic: On gengshen day Annam sent tribute of local products.

s0333.literal: The Jiangxi Branch Secretariat recommended military officials; an order dismissed them.
s0333.idiomatic: The Jiangxi Branch Secretariat recommended military officials; an order dismissed them.

s0334.literal: On renxu day an edict instructed officials and people of the three cities of Woduan and others and Qutudaier to register Bulangxi population.
s0334.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict instructed officials and people of the three cities of Woduan and others and Qutudaier to register Bulangxi population.

s0335.literal: Lianghuai transport commissioner Alawadin was executed for embezzling twenty-one thousand five hundred ingots of official notes, stealing three hundred forty-four government-purchased horses, withholding imperial orders and not promulgating them, and unauthorized trading with household slaves using official tally seals.
s0335.idiomatic: Lianghuai transport commissioner Alawadin was executed for embezzling 21,500 ingots of official notes, stealing 344 government-purchased horses, withholding imperial orders and not promulgating them, and unauthorized trading with household slaves using official tally seals.

s0336.literal: Granted notes, silks, fur clothing, and the like to garrison farmers at Qian Prefecture, and issued farming and fishing implements.
s0336.idiomatic: Notes, silks, fur clothing, and the like were granted to garrison farmers at Qian Prefecture, and farming and fishing implements were issued.

s0337.literal: Reimbursed relay artisans and others for sheep and horses contributed to the army.
s0337.idiomatic: Relay artisans and others were reimbursed for sheep and horses contributed to the army.

s0338.literal: Ninth month, guihai new moon: hunted in the near suburbs.
s0338.idiomatic: Ninth month, guihai new moon: hunted in the near suburbs.

s0339.literal: On jiazi day Dadu patrol troops were increased by one thousand.
s0339.idiomatic: On jiazi day Dadu patrol troops were increased by 1,000.

s0340.literal: Issued notes to relieve famine victims at Shangdu.
s0340.idiomatic: Notes were issued to relieve famine victims at Shangdu.

s0341.literal: On guiyou day, for merchant maritime goods already assessed at Quanzhou, trade at other places required only payment of tax.
s0341.idiomatic: On guiyou day, for merchant maritime goods already assessed at Quanzhou, trade at other places required only payment of tax.

s0342.literal: Increased Tamna garrison troops and ordered Goryeo to supply military equipment.
s0342.idiomatic: Tamna garrison troops were increased and Goryeo was ordered to supply military equipment.

s0343.literal: On gengchen day returned to the palace.
s0343.idiomatic: On gengchen day the emperor returned to the palace.

s0344.literal: On xinsi day garrison farms were established at Mongol relay stations in Dadu; registered households paying annual lump-sum silver and stray households in Zhending and other routes were all ordered to garrison-farm; those in Zhending were exempted from fur goods levies.
s0344.idiomatic: On xinsi day garrison farms were established at Mongol relay stations in Dadu; registered households paying annual lump-sum silver and stray households in Zhending and other routes were all ordered to garrison-farm; those in Zhending were exempted from fur goods levies.

s0345.literal: On guiwei day the annual tax quota of Jingzhao and other routes was raised from nineteen thousand to fifty-four thousand ingots; Ahmad still thought it insufficient and wanted to audit it.
s0345.idiomatic: On guiwei day the annual tax quota of Jingzhao and other routes was raised from 19,000 to 54,000 ingots; Ahmad still thought it insufficient and wanted to audit it.

s0346.literal: The emperor said: "What does Ahmad know.
s0346.idiomatic: The emperor said, "What does Ahmad know?

s0348.literal: People of Dadu and Xin'an County again bore corvée purchase requisitions.
s0348.idiomatic: People of Dadu and Xin'an County again bore corvée purchase requisitions.

s0349.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0349.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0350.literal: On renchen day Champa sent tribute of local products.
s0350.idiomatic: On renchen day Champa sent tribute of local products.

s0351.literal: Granted notes, silks, and cloth in graded amounts to guard troops repairing Dadu walls; rewarded northern expedition troops with silver notes.
s0351.idiomatic: Notes, silks, and cloth in graded amounts were granted to guard troops repairing Dadu walls, and northern expedition troops were rewarded with silver notes.

s0352.literal: Granted sheep, horses, clothing, and silks in graded amounts to qielian retainers, those under the four ordos, and officers and soldiers under Fan Wenhu.
s0352.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, clothing, and silks in graded amounts were granted to qielian retainers, those under the four ordos, and officers and soldiers under Fan Wenhu.

s0353.literal: Winter, tenth month, yiwei day: offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Empress Zhenyishun Shengzhao Tianrui Wenguang Ying was enshrined.
s0353.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, yiwei day: offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Empress Zhenyishun Shengzhao Tianrui Wenguang Ying was enshrined.

s0354.literal: On bingshen day commoners were recruited for garrison farming in Huai-west.
s0354.idiomatic: On bingshen day commoners were recruited for garrison farming in Huai-west.

s0355.literal: On jihai day deliberation was held on enfeoffing the king of Annam; the Uighur-script tiger tally granted to Annam was replaced with one inscribed in the national script;
s0355.idiomatic: On jihai day deliberation was held on enfeoffing the king of Annam; the Uighur-script tiger tally granted to Annam was replaced with one inscribed in the national script;

s0356.literal: An edict was also issued instructing Annam to install Ri Xuan's uncle Yiai as king of Annam.
s0356.idiomatic: An edict was also issued instructing Annam to install Ri Xuan's uncle Yiai as king of Annam.

s0357.literal: On gengzi day newly submitted xidong official and Zhen'an Prefecture prefect Cen Congyi let his troops kill and plunder, forcing prefect Li Xianzu to death; Congyi was summoned to audience.
s0357.idiomatic: On gengzi day newly submitted xidong official and Zhen'an Prefecture prefect Cen Congyi let his troops kill and plunder, forcing prefect Li Xianzu to death; Congyi was summoned to audience.

s0358.literal: On renyin day Japan expedition officers and commanders were granted clothing, silks, boots, and hats in graded amounts.
s0358.idiomatic: On renyin day Japan expedition officers and commanders were granted clothing, silks, boots, and hats in graded amounts.

s0359.literal: On yisi day Anxi Prince's xieji households and Nanshan pass troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Anxi, Yan'an, Fengxiang, Liupan, and other places.
s0359.idiomatic: On yisi day Anxi Prince's xieji households and Nanshan pass troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Anxi, Yan'an, Fengxiang, Liupan, and other places.

s0360.literal: A bureau for supervising wool-weaving artisans was established in Hexi.
s0360.idiomatic: A bureau for supervising wool-weaving artisans was established in Hexi.

s0361.literal: On dingwei day a pacification and consolation commission was established in Annam; Dadu Route darughachi Baidu Temür was made associate administrator and acting Annam pacification commissioner, with grand commander and tiger-tally bearer Chai Chun and Hu Koer as deputies.
s0361.idiomatic: On dingwei day a pacification and consolation commission was established in Annam; Dadu Route darughachi Baidu Temür was made associate administrator and acting Annam pacification commissioner, with grand commander and tiger-tally bearer Chai Chun and Hu Koer as deputies.

s0362.literal: Granted ten thousand ingots of notes to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for operating expenses.
s0362.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for operating expenses.

s0363.literal: On jiyou day Zhang Yi and others said: "Examining Daoist texts, only the Daodejing was personally authored by Laozi; the rest were all later forgeries and should be entirely burned.
s0363.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhang Yi and others said, "Examining Daoist texts, only the Daodejing was personally authored by Laozi; the rest were all later forgeries and should be entirely burned.

s0364.literal: " Approved; an edict also instructed the empire.
s0364.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved, and an edict also instructed the empire.

s0365.literal: Issued sea-eagle tally seals to the Longxing Branch Secretariat.
s0365.idiomatic: Sea-eagle tally seals were issued to the Longxing Branch Secretariat.

s0366.literal: Shilizhaya Xinhebala Mahediewa was made Prince of Champa, promoted to grand master of glorious blessing, and granted a tiger tally.
s0366.idiomatic: Shilizhaya Xinhebala Mahediewa was made Prince of Champa, promoted to grand master of glorious blessing, and granted a tiger tally.

s0367.literal: A Champa branch secretariat was established.
s0367.idiomatic: A Champa branch secretariat was established.

s0368.literal: Suodu was made right vice minister, Liu Shen left vice minister, and Ministry of War vice minister Yelimissi associate administrator.
s0368.idiomatic: Suodu was made right vice minister, Liu Shen left vice minister, and Ministry of War vice minister Yelimissi associate administrator.

s0369.literal: On gengxu day an edict ordered one hundred sea ships, old and new troops and sailors totaling ten thousand men, to campaign against various overseas fan in the first month of next year; the Prince of Champa was also instructed to supply army provisions.
s0369.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered 100 sea ships, old and new troops and sailors totaling 10,000 men, to campaign against various overseas fan in the first month of next year; the Prince of Champa was also instructed to supply army provisions.

s0370.literal: When Annam king Chen Yiai entered Annam, one thousand newly submitted troops were dispatched to escort him.
s0370.idiomatic: When Annam king Chen Yiai entered Annam, 1,000 newly submitted troops were dispatched to escort him.

s0371.literal: An edict instructed Ganbuxi country to come and submit.
s0371.idiomatic: An edict instructed Ganbuxi country to come and submit.

s0372.literal: On renzi day, following Helihuosun's proposal, two Mongol school commissioner posts were established in each of the four provinces of Yangzhou, Longxing, Ezhou, and Quanzhou.
s0372.idiomatic: On renzi day, following Helihuosun's proposal, two Mongol school commissioner posts were established in each of the four provinces of Yangzhou, Longxing, Ezhou, and Quanzhou.

s0373.literal: Hanlin academician-expositor Saliman was also put in charge of the Reception Hall and Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand councillor and privy council vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the Imperial Library, Astronomical Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy; Hanlin academician-expositor Helihuosun was ordered to retain the post of minister of education.
s0373.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-expositor Saliman was also put in charge of the Reception Hall and Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand councillor and privy council vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the Imperial Library, Astronomical Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy; Hanlin academician-expositor Helihuosun was ordered to retain the post of minister of education.

s0374.literal: The Bolangxi garrison-farm headquarters for Dadu, Nanyang, Zhending, and other places was changed to an Agriculture Administration.
s0374.idiomatic: The Bolangxi garrison-farm headquarters for Dadu, Nanyang, Zhending, and other places was changed to an Agriculture Administration.

s0375.literal: On guichou day the crown prince arrived from the northern frontier.
s0375.idiomatic: On guichou day the crown prince arrived from the northern frontier.

s0376.literal: On bingchen day, following Uryangqadai's report that people and livestock at the four relay stations south of Shangdu were exhausted, notes were granted to supply them.
s0376.idiomatic: On bingchen day, following Uryangqadai's report that people and livestock at the four relay stations south of Shangdu were exhausted, notes were granted to supply them.

s0377.literal: On gengshen day Western Sichuan households were registered.
s0377.idiomatic: On gengshen day Western Sichuan households were registered.

s0378.literal: On xinyou day Shaowu rebel Gao Rixin submitted.
s0378.idiomatic: On xinyou day Shaowu rebel Gao Rixin submitted.

s0379.literal: Issued winter clothing to guard newly submitted troops returning from the Japan expedition.
s0379.idiomatic: Winter clothing was issued to guard newly submitted troops returning from the Japan expedition.

s0380.literal: Granted silver and silks to Liu Tiansi and others, paper currency for sheep and horses to Shengwula and others, and horses, cattle, and sheep to princes including Ajji in graded amounts.
s0380.idiomatic: Silver and silks were granted to Liu Tiansi and others, paper currency for sheep and horses to Shengwula and others, and horses, cattle, and sheep to princes including Ajji in graded amounts.

s0381.literal: Eleventh month, guihai new moon: an edict instructed Tanmali to submit.
s0381.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai new moon: an edict instructed Tanmali to submit.

s0382.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered execution of Chen Diaoyan's ringleaders; the rest had their weapons confiscated and were sent to the capital in custody.
s0382.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered execution of Chen Diaoyan's ringleaders; the rest had their weapons confiscated and were sent to the capital in custody.

s0383.literal: On jisi day the Directorate of Armaments was ordered to supply weapons to Goryeo coastal commanderies.
s0383.idiomatic: On jisi day the Directorate of Armaments was ordered to supply weapons to Goryeo coastal commanderies.

s0384.literal: Champa envoys Meng Qingyuan and Sun Shengfu were both made Guangzhou pacification commissioners, also overseeing expedition logistics.
s0384.idiomatic: Champa envoys Meng Qingyuan and Sun Shengfu were both made Guangzhou pacification commissioners, also overseeing expedition logistics.

s0385.literal: In Goryeo, Jin Prefecture, and other places frontier defense wanhu headquarters were established to control Japan.
s0385.idiomatic: In Goryeo, Jin Prefecture, and other places frontier defense wanhu headquarters were established to control Japan.

s0386.literal: Gao Rixin and his brother Dingxin and others came to court; because Rixin had twice been a rebel leader, he was given a civilian post in the Shanbei Route.
s0386.idiomatic: Gao Rixin and his brother Dingxin and others came to court; because Rixin had twice been a rebel leader, he was given a civilian post in the Shanbei Route.

s0387.literal: Wen Qing's followers were sent back to Quanzhou.
s0387.idiomatic: Wen Qing's followers were sent back to Quanzhou.

s0388.literal: Granted two hundred twenty-three meritorious officers and commanders one hundred thousand taels of silver and silks, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles in graded amounts.
s0388.idiomatic: 223 meritorious officers and commanders were granted 100,000 taels of silver and silks, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles in graded amounts.

s0389.literal: An edict ordered the king of Annam to supply provisions to the Champa branch secretariat army.
s0389.idiomatic: An edict ordered the king of Annam to supply provisions to the Champa branch secretariat army.

s0390.literal: The Goryeo king requested to complete coastal fortifications against Japan; not approved.
s0390.idiomatic: The Goryeo king requested to complete coastal fortifications against Japan; the request was not approved.

s0391.literal: On xinwei day Prince Ajji was granted six thousand shi of grain.
s0391.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Ajji was granted 6,000 shi of grain.

s0392.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the star south of the second Wuche.
s0392.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the star south of the second Wuche.

s0393.literal: On yihai day Daoist master Liu Daozhen was summoned to inquire about rites for offering to Taiyi.
s0393.idiomatic: On yihai day Daoist master Liu Daozhen was summoned to inquire about rites for offering to Taiyi.

s0394.literal: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Gui.
s0394.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Gui.

s0395.literal: On renwu day an edict instructed the king of Java to come to court in person.
s0395.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict instructed the king of Java to come to court in person.

s0396.literal: People of Chang Prefecture and Gaili Lake suffered famine; notes were issued for relief.
s0396.idiomatic: People of Chang Prefecture and Gaili Lake suffered famine; notes were issued for relief.

s0397.literal: On bingxu day twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted for trade at Karakorum.
s0397.idiomatic: On bingxu day 20,000 ingots of notes were granted for trade at Karakorum.

s0398.literal: Ordered late-returning troops from the Japan expedition to garrison the coast in divisions.
s0398.idiomatic: Late-returning troops from the Japan expedition were ordered to garrison the coast in divisions.

s0399.literal: On dinghai day the moon occulted the eastern star of the Heart.
s0399.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon occulted the eastern star of the Heart.

s0400.literal: Granted notes to newly submitted army officers and commanders of the Yangzhou Branch Secretariat, two ingots per man.
s0400.idiomatic: Notes were granted to newly submitted army officers and commanders of the Yangzhou Branch Secretariat, two ingots per man.
